exposure: Abdominal surgeries (including cesarean section and hysterectomy)
cohort: 322 women between the ages of 40 and 80
finding: Each full-term pregnancy and hysterectomy are significantly associated with an increased risk of developing DS.
mod_finding: The number of full-term pregnancies, but not cesarean section, was a significant predictor of degenerative spondylolisthesis in women.
